title: Home guide: the spoon test (thermal conductors)
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Properties of materials and habitats (Alchemy Island and Living Things and Their Habitats)
source: Written for science/y5 lesson 11 (Home practical guide and safety card: spoon test (portal worksheet; warm tap water only, adult pours))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Find out which material conducts heat best.
safety: Warm tap water only; an adult pours it
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: An adult pours warm tap water into the mug.
Stand the three spoons in the water.
Touch the top of each handle. Which feels warmest?

head: Spoon
